latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the OLTP/OLAP Workload Classifier skill.
- Classifies workloads as OLTP, OLAP, or hybrid to recommend suitable database architectures.
- Guides structured information gathering around query patterns, users, write behavior, data volume, and latency needs.
- Uses a 6-dimension scoring matrix to differentiate transactional and analytical workloads.
- Recommends when to use transactional databases, data warehouses, or combined/HTAP solutions.
- Clarifies when to use related skills (data-model-selector, storage-engine-selector, batch/stream pipeline designers) for adjacent concerns.
